warnings.message: Word body semantics are reconstructed. Inline emphasis, style-based visibility, typography, page layout, sections, headers/footers, notes/comments, equations, charts and metadata beyond title are not fully mapped. Links and images may follow their containing block. Original material is available only with source retention.
The matching opening Word title becomes the PRD document title; its bookmark target is retained.
Section page sizes, breaks, columns, headers and footers are not mapped to responsive document layout.
12 archive members are not mapped into reading, including unused media, metadata or unsupported Word parts. They remain available only with source retention.
